frozen_b2_language.operands: literals over root or earlier extension variables

proved_in_this_pass: standard literal-AND Extended Resolution normalizes directly into B2
OR-literal extension presentations normalize via De Morgan and polarity renaming
strictly increasing extension ids are obtained by introduction-order renaming
unused proof nodes and unused extension definitions can be pruned without increasing proof size
B2 refutations are ordinary Extended Resolution refutations after dropping portability metadata
B2 and Extended Resolution are polynomially equivalent on UNSAT CNF refutations

frontier_equivalence.statement: Every UNSAT CNF has a polynomial-size B2 certificate iff Extended Resolution is p-bounded on CNF refutations, up to standard polynomial encoding translations.

complexity_consequences.if_positive: Polynomial-size B2 certificates plus polynomial verification imply UNSAT in NP and hence NP = coNP. This does not establish P = NP without deterministic polynomial proof discovery.
complexity_consequences.if_negative: A superpolynomial B2 lower bound yields an Extended Resolution / Extended Frege lower-bound breakthrough up to p-equivalence. ER non-p-boundedness is not currently known by itself to imply NP != coNP.
